acceptance: RED first: a minted profile with a bare family CLI name either never occurs (minter resolves) or fails the mint step loudly at mint time, not at the NEXT loop launch.
Preflight and dispatch resolve profile CLI names through ONE shared function.
cd go && go test -race ./internal/core/... ./internal/subagent/... N/N PASS.
evidence: The batch-15 advisor mint wrote .evolve/profiles/gate-wiring-proof.json with cli:"claude" while every hand-authored profile carries the driver-suffixed name (cli:"claude-tmux", "codex-tmux"). The FIRST loop launch that ran preflight over the minted stub (runtime-plane relaunch, 2026-07-28T12:15) HALTed readiness: pipeline-structure: profile "gate-wiring-proof": CLI "claude" resolves to no known driver. Batch-15 never noticed because its launches predate the mint; dispatch itself tolerated the bare name (cycles 1158/1159 ran the phase) — so mint output passes DISPATCH but fails PREFLIGHT: two resolvers, two vocabularies. Operator-patched to claude-tmux in the runtime plane to unblock.
notes: Fix at the MINTER: the advisor mint must emit the resolved driver name (the same translation dispatch applies), and a mint-time validation should run the SAME resolver preflight uses (single vocabulary — never_duplicate_centralize). A regression predicate: minted profile passes `evolve doctor`/readiness pipeline-structure check the moment it is written. | [SCOPE WIDENED 2026-08-05] The class is mint/seed CONTRACT-COMPLETENESS, not just driver suffixes: lane provisioning seeds the plane's on-disk profile stubs into every lane; an incomplete stub (ship-stage-hygiene-check, empty cli) failed TestSmoke_RealProfiles in-lane and the repo-contract ship gate blocked correctly (cycle ~1331). Plane copies operator-completed (cli/role/tier); the durable fix: mint+seed output must satisfy ALL profile contracts (name/role/cli fields, driver-suffix naming, persona pairing or reasoned allowlist) — or seeding excludes gitignored stubs. Weight raised to 0.9.
title: Advisor phase mint writes bare CLI names into profiles — preflight pipeline-structure HALTs on 'claude resolves to no known driver'
